name: Travis Hogue
bio:
Travis Hogue stands out in the industry with their adept skill in crafting illustrative, floral, and geometric tattoos that are both intricate and unique. Their professionalism is evident in every aspect of their work, from the initial design consultation to the final, stunning tattoo result. As the artist and owner of ‘Art of Ink’ Tattoo Studio, Travis brings a refined touch to every piece they create, ensuring that clients leave not only with a beautiful work of art but also with a positive experience characterized by Travis's commitment to excellence.
